newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - CEMEX INITIATED AS BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CEMEX INITIATED AS BUY.

text.p: ABN AMRO on Friday said it initiated coverage of Cemex with a buy rating.

"We have set a price target of US $14.00 per ADR in dollar terms over the current share price, and the downturn after interims provides an excellent buying opportunity," analyst Carlos Perezalonso wrote in a report.
He wrote in a report that despite the company's high debt level, Cemex's expansion plans have eliminated its dependence on any one nation's economy.
Cemex's shares in Mexico stood down 0.30 peso to 47.50 in midday trading and the American Depositary Receipts (ADR) stood unchanged from Thursday's close at 12\02.
